items.informal_name: Evaluation Preserves Subtraction in Multivariate Polynomials
items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and ring $ S_1 $, and for any polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ in the multivariate polynomial ring $ R[\sigma] $, the evaluation of $ p - q $ under coefficient map $ f : R \to S_1 $ and variable map $ g : \sigma \to S_1 $ satisfies $ (p - q).\text{eval}_2(f, g) = p.\text{eval}_2(f, g) - q.\text{eval}_2(f, g) $.

items.informal_name: Subtraction Commutes with Evaluation of Bivariate Polynomials
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Ring R] (x y : R) (p q : Polynomial (Polynomial R)),
  Polynomial.evalEval x y (p - q) = Polynomial.evalEval x y p - Polynomial.evalEval x y q
items.informal_description: For elements $x, y$ in a semiring $R$ and bivariate polynomials $p, q \in R[X][Y]$, the evaluation of the difference $p - q$ at $x$ and $y$ equals the difference of the evaluations of $p$ and $q$ at $x$ and $y$. Formally, $(p - q)(x, y) = p(x, y) - q(x, y)$.

items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (f g : Poly α) (x : α → ℕ), (f - g) x = f x - g x
items.informal_description: For any integer polynomials $f$ and $g$ in variables indexed by $\alpha$, and for any exponent vector $x : \alpha \to \mathbb{N}$, the value of the polynomial $f - g$ at $x$ is equal to the difference of the values of $f$ and $g$ at $x$, i.e., $(f - g)(x) = f(x) - g(x)$.

items.informal_name: Evaluation Preserves Subtraction in Multivariate Polynomials
items.type:

items.informal_description: For any commutative ring $ R $, type $ \sigma $, and evaluation map $ f : \sigma \to R $, the evaluation of the difference of two multivariate polynomials $ p $ and $ q $ satisfies $ \operatorname{eval}_f(p - q) = \operatorname{eval}_f(p) - \operatorname{eval}_f(q) $.
